tagline: Remove duplicate subscribers: Dashboard authors can now remove duplicate subscribers from a dashboard schedule.
what_it_does: Remove duplicate subscribers: Dashboard authors can now remove duplicate subscribers from a dashboard schedule. Import BI filters fix: Fixed a bug where some filters were not created when importing Power BI and Tableau reports with Genie Code (/importBI). Reversed y axis tooltip order fix: Fixed a bug where tooltips for line and area charts with a reversed y axis listed their series in the wrong order.
why_it_matters: Promoted metric views are reusable across dashboards, Genie Agents, and notebooks, and get full Unity Catalog governance: access controls, lineage, and discoverability.
